lines.beaver_en: Minji, did you back up the interview file?
lines.learner: 네, 과학자 인터뷰는 했어요. 그런데 좀 걱정돼요.
lines.en: Yes, I backed up the scientist interview. But I'm a bit worried.
lines.roman: Ne, gwahakja inteobyuneun haesseoyo. Geureonde jom geokjeongdwaeyo.

lines.learner: 녹음 파일에 과학자 개인 정보가 있어서요.
lines.en: The recording file has the scientist's personal information.
lines.roman: Nogeum paire gwahakja gaein jeongboga isseoseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, that interview with the space scientist?
lines.learner: 네. 파일에 꼭 비밀번호를 걸지 않으면 안 돼요.
lines.en: Yes. We must put a password on the file.
lines.roman: Ne. Paire kkok bimilbeonhoreul geolji aneumyeon an dwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you save it on the laptop too?
lines.en: Yes, I saved it on the laptop too.

lines.beaver: 녹음기에 있는 파일은 어떻게 할 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: What will you do with the file on the recorder?
lines.beaver_roman: Nogeumgie inneun paireun eotteoke hal kkeoyeyo?
lines.learner: 노트북에 옮긴 후에 삭제하지 않으면 안 돼요.
lines.en: I have to delete it after moving it to the laptop.
lines.roman: Noteubuge omgin hue sakjehaji aneumyeon an dwaeyo.

lines.en: Yes, I put 'universe' in the file name and search.

lines.beaver_en: These days all our data is on computers.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 메일 보안도 신경 써야 돼요.
lines.en: Right. We need to watch email security too.
lines.roman: Majayo. Meil boando singyeong sseoya dwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I heard information leaked at another newspaper.
lines.learner: 우리 신문사도 조심하지 않으면 안 돼요.
lines.en: Our newspaper has to be careful too.
lines.roman: Uri sinmunsado josimhaji aneumyeon an dwaeyo.

lines.beaver: 아까 민지 씨 자리 화면이 꺼져 있던데요.
lines.beaver_en: Your screen was off earlier, though.
lines.beaver_roman: Akka Minji ssi jari hwamyeoni kkeojyeo itdeondeyo.
lines.learner: 그래도 마우스를 움직이면 모니터에 다 보여요.
lines.en: Still, if you move the mouse, everything shows on the monitor.
lines.roman: Geuraedo mauseureul umjigimyeon moniteoe da boyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 이따 이 얘기 더 해요. 점심 같이 먹을래요?
lines.beaver_en: Let's talk more later. Want to have lunch together?
lines.beaver_roman: Itta i yaegi deo haeyo. Jeomsim gachi meogeullaeyo?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 보안 이야기는 점심 먹으면서 해요.
lines.en: Sure. Let's talk about security over lunch.
lines.roman: Joayo. Boan iyagineun jeomsim meogeumyeonseo haeyo.
